Text: Control flow is the {{c1::order}} in which statements execute.
Extra: Branches and loops change this order.

Text: An `if` condition in Java must be a {{c1::boolean}} expression.
Extra: Java does not accept `if (1)`.

Text: In an `else if` chain, Java runs the {{c1::first matching}} branch.
Extra: Later branches are skipped.

Text: An `else` binds to the {{c1::nearest unmatched if}}.
Extra: This is the dangling `else` rule.

Text: A {{c1::guard clause}} handles a special or invalid case early.
Extra: It often uses `return`.

Text: Traditional switch {{c1::fall-through}} happens when a case lacks an exit such as `break`.
Extra: Execution continues into the next case.

Text: A `while` loop checks its condition {{c1::before}} each iteration.
Extra: It can run zero times.

Text: A `do-while` loop checks its condition {{c1::after}} each iteration.
Extra: The body runs at least once.

Text: A classic `for` loop header contains {{c1::initialization}}, {{c2::condition}}, and {{c3::update}}.
Extra: These describe the counter pattern.

Text: Enhanced `for` is best when you need each element but not the {{c1::index}}.
Extra: It reads arrays or iterables cleanly.

Text: An {{c1::iteration}} is one pass through a loop body.
Extra: This term helps count loop execution.

Text: An {{c1::infinite loop}} does not naturally stop.
Extra: It may be intentional or accidental.

Text: `break` exits the nearest {{c1::loop or switch}}.
Extra: Labeled `break` can target a named outer loop.

Text: `continue` skips the rest of the current {{c1::loop iteration}}.
Extra: The loop then moves toward the next iteration.

Text: `return` exits the current {{c1::method}}.
Extra: In a non-void method, it returns a value.

Text: A switch {{c1::expression}} produces a value.
Extra: A switch statement performs actions.

Text: Arrow switch cases use {{c1::->}} and do not fall through.
Extra: This reduces missing-break bugs.

Text: `yield` provides a value for a {{c1::switch expression}} branch.
Extra: It is not the same as `return`.

Text: A switch expression must be {{c1::exhaustive}}.
Extra: It must always produce a value.

Text: A labeled `break` can exit a named {{c1::outer loop}}.
Extra: Plain `break` exits only the nearest loop.
